messages:
maria: Quick sync — need to lock scope for Launch A. Proposed consolidation: move 'tenant analytics' -> v1, keep 'realtime batching' in MVP, cut 'admin UI polish' from MVP. Ping @jon for infra impact, @tara for QA. Timeline still EOW RC? :thinking_face:
jon: Realtime batching is infra-heavy but quantized model helps. If we keep it for MVP we need ~2 extra dev-weeks or 1 week with a tolerance for higher latency. Prefer keep but make it opt-in behind a flag.
tara: QA headcount is tight this sprint. If batching stays in MVP we need to deprioritize a regression test set. I can take ownership if we shift a cosmetic out.
chris: Admin UI polish is cosmetic; cut for MVP. Create a v1 backlog ticket and tag with UX debt.
eva: Heads-up: ACME has flagged analytics as a GA requirement. Moving analytics to v1 risks their buy-in.
maria: Tradeoffs summarized: keep analytics in MVP -> timeline risk; move to v1 -> possible loss of ACME. Two suggested mitigations: 1) keep analytics as an "enterprise preview" (limited tenants) 2) postpone to v1. Pros/cons?
jon: Option 1 seems feasible: enterprise preview reduces scale surface. Work estimate: infra 3d + dev 2d + feature flag.
tara: From QA POV preview reduces surface area — acceptable if rollout is gated and docs are clear.
chris: Option 1 preferred. Will own the v1 backlog ticket for full analytics and ensure migration path.
maria: Quick vote: reply with :one: for enterprise preview or :two: for move-to-v1
jon: :one:
tara: :one:
eva: :two: (I still need legal to sign off for ACME)
chris: :one:
maria: Vote tally looks like 3 x :one:, 1 x :two:. Consensus: ship analytics as enterprise preview. Action items: 
- maria: write preview requirements + acceptance criteria (ETA today)
- jon: infra plan + feature flag implementation (ETA Wed)
- tara: QA plan + smoke tests (ETA Thu)
- chris: create v1 backlog ticket + rollout playbook (ETA Fri)

maria: Draft acceptance criteria (putting here so it's visible):
```
- Preview enabled via org-level feature flag
- Preview limited to up to 5 tenant orgs
- Basic ingestion + dashboard with subset of metrics (no advanced queries)
- No SLA commitment for preview (explicitly stated)
- Docs and known-issues published before roll
```
product-bot: :information_source: Reminder: Feature flag policy requires a kill-switch and emergency off path. See https://redwood.dev/feature-flags for checklist.
maria: I'll add this to the milestone doc and update the cutlist now. Calling out potential hidden deps — please flag here if you see any.
jon: Filing infra ticket IR-482 for autoscaler tweaks and flag gating.
chris: Scheduling a 30m handoff with infra + support tomorrow 9:30am PT — invite sent.
tara: I'll start the test matrix and loop support on smoke coverage.
eva: I'll escalate ACME legal conversation but proceed with preview path for now.
maria: Thanks — locking scope for the milestone based on the preview decision. I'll post updated milestone + PRD link when done. :thumbsup:
